items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, Don Redman! Oh, Don I thought was great. He was. And I didn't know him before, you know.

ctx.x: Did any of the saxophonists in Henderson's band impress you at the time?

Yeah, Don Redman! Oh, Don I thought was great. He was. And I didn't know him before, you know. And Buster Bailey with the clarinet, oh...! Hawkins was a sensation, you know. Yeah, the whole reed section impressed me. And then when they'd play together.
And they doubled on everything, too.
